SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "user_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "order_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("ts") as min_date,
  MAX("ts") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders"

SELECT "user_id"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "ts" <= ?
AND "ts" > ?

SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, ts AS "TS", price AS "PRICE"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."ORDERS"
  ON user_id = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND ts <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND ts > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE ts <= ?
AND ts > ?

WITH TMP as (

WITH TMP as (

    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, order_id AS "ORDER_ID", user_id AS "USER_ID", ts AS "TS", price AS "PRICE", price * 1.2 AS "PRICE_WITH_TAX"

  ON user_id = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND ts <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND ts > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE ts <= ?
  AND ts > ?
